entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie... I'm hoping you can help me. I need to return a VeloBand I ordered a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, no, the band itself is fine. I haven't even opened it. It's just... circumstances have changed, and I can't use it now. I've been a loyal customer for a while and was really hoping to get the money back.
I understand. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 15th. That makes it 17 days ago. I'm very sorry to be the one to say this, but our return policy for the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day window due to hygiene protocols and how the device activates.

Ten days? Oh, no. I had no idea. I... I feel awful. The thing is, right after it arrived, my husband had a huge medical **emergency**. He's active military, and right before his **deployment** was scheduled, he needed unexpected **surgery**. I've been at the **hospital** with him day and night. It's the only thing on my mind. I'm so sorry, I really need that money back for our bills.

Oh my, please don't apologize. That sounds incredibly stressful, and I'm so sorry to hear you're both going through that. Family absolutely comes first. Given those circumstances, let me see what I can do. That certainly qualifies for an exception.

Yes, absolutely. We can make a one-time exception for this. I'm going to go ahead and authorize a full refund for you. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email on your account right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Really? Oh, thank you, Charlie! You have no idea what a relief that is. I was so worried. Thank you so, so much for understanding.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you during such a difficult time. The email with the label should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. We wish your husband a very swift recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
